label: stand 1
title: Stand on your spot
instruction: Stand still on your spot, facing the camera.

label: walk straight
title: Walk straight
instruction: Walk in place on your spot, facing the camera, at an easy pace.

label: walk left
title: Walk to the left
instruction: Turn your body to your LEFT and walk in place, as if walking off to the left. Keep your face towards the camera if you can.

label: walk right
title: Walk to the right
instruction: Turn your body to your RIGHT and walk in place, as if walking off to the right. Keep your face towards the camera if you can.

label: walk changing
title: Walk and change direction
instruction: Walk in place all the time. Each time you are called, turn to walk to the LEFT, STRAIGHT or to the RIGHT.

label: stand 5
title: Stand
instruction: Stand still, facing the camera. Done soon.
